activity_summary: Before nine you said the share again, six-and-twenty, the first since July, and you left the coffer shut at twenty pound fifteen. The letter is tomorrow, after the bells. You went to bed.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the memo and went to bed.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Six-and-twenty shillings at the reckoning, the first share since July

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Tomorrow, after the bells, the letter
